t_advice_summary_textbox.text: choose the gnome colours that correspond with the baskets

vb_textbox.text: The relationship between the mushroom count and the gnome seems to vary. I found that the gnome choice after the basket colour started as closest in hue, but then changed to opposite hues as the game progressed. I found it difficult to fin any kind of pattern to follow. The same gnomes seemed to be high/low scoring throughout the game (brown better than orange, blue better than purple, pink was often low scoring)
